snippet.title: The Rings of Powder - First Trailer
snippet.description:
This if the very first trailer for our new incomming game called "The Rings of Powder".

The Rings of Powder is an rts game with procedurally generated dungeons.

Release date planned for 10.2023 on Steam.

Steam link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2188570/The_Rings_of_Powder/
